parts.args:
{"source":"data","name":"customer_with_most_paid_orders","sql":"SELECT c.customer, COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.customer
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1"}
